opportunities.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS) 2026-27
opportunities.summary: Central government merit scholarship for students from families earning up to ₹4.5 lakh a year who scored above the 80th percentile in Class XII and now study in a regular degree course.
opportunities.description:
Run by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, under the Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Yojana. Up to 82,000 fresh scholarships are awarded each year on the basis of Class XII Board results, and 50% are earmarked for girls. The scholarship is renewed each year if you score at least 50% in the annual examination and keep at least 75% attendance.

Applications are made only on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). NSP shows student applications for 2026-27 open until 30 November 2026.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Above 80th percentile in Class XII (your stream and board), regular degree course, family income up to ₹4.5 lakh a year, no other scholarship or fee waiver.
opportunities.benefits: ₹12,000 per year at graduation level (first three years) and ₹20,000 per year at post-graduation level. B.Tech/B.E. students get ₹12,000 a year for years 1–3 and ₹20,000 in the 4th year. Paid by DBT into a bank account in your own name.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) before 30 Nov 2026 — applications sent directly to the Ministry are not accepted.
2. Your institute verifies your application, then the State Higher Education Department (State Nodal Agency).
3. The selection list is shown on NSP.
4. The scholarship is paid by DBT to a bank account in your name; track it with “Know Your Payment” on the PFMS portal.

opportunities.title: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies (UGC) 2026-27
opportunities.summary: UGC merit scholarship of ₹15,000 a month for students in the first year of their first regular PG degree, with 30% of slots reserved for women.
opportunities.description:
Up to 10,000 scholarships (or as decided by UGC) at ₹15,000 per month for 10 months a year, for two years, to pursue a postgraduate degree in India. Selection is on all-India merit. 30% of slots are reserved for women and are first filled by single, twin or fraternal girl child applicants without considering their UG marks. Half of the slots in each category are for Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law and Management, and half for Science, Engineering & Technology, Medical, Technical, Agriculture and Forestry programmes.

Apply on the National Scholarship Portal. NSP shows student applications for 2026-27 open until 30 November 2026.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: First year of your first regular PG degree, below 30 at PG admission, at an eligible UGC-recognised NAAC-accredited or government institution.
opportunities.benefits: ₹15,000 per month for 10 months a year, for two years. Paid directly into your Aadhaar-linked bank account.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) before 30 Nov 2026.
2. Your institution verifies the application (it needs a valid AISHE code on NSP).
3. Results are declared on NSP (normally in November/December) and on the UGC website.
4. Keep your bank account Aadhaar-linked and verified to receive payments.

opportunities.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree) 2026-27
opportunities.summary: ₹50,000 a year for girls in the first year of an AICTE-approved technical degree (or second year through lateral entry) with family income up to ₹8 lakh.
opportunities.description:
Implemented by AICTE to support girls in technical education. Selection is on the merit of the qualifying examination (10+2 or equivalent), with state/UT-wise merit lists. Applications are invited once a year on the National Scholarship Portal and are verified by your institute and the State/UT Department of Technical Education. The scholarship is renewed each year if you are promoted to the next year.

NSP shows student applications for 2026-27 open until 30 November 2026. A separate Pragati scheme for technical diploma students is listed on NSP with the same deadline.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Girls in 1st-year degree (or 2nd-year lateral entry) at an AICTE-approved institution, family income up to ₹8 lakh, maximum two girls per family.
opportunities.benefits: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study (up to 4 years; up to 3 years for lateral entry), as a lump sum towards college fee, computer, books, stationery, equipment and software. Paid by DBT once a year.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) before 30 Nov 2026.
2. Your institute verifies your application.
3. The State/UT Department of Technical Education verifies it as the second level.
4. Selected students are paid by DBT; renew every year on NSP with your passing certificate or marksheet.

opportunities.title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-abled Students (Technical Degree) 2026-27
opportunities.summary: ₹50,000 a year for students with 40% or more disability in the first year of an AICTE-approved technical degree (or second year through lateral entry), family income up to ₹8 lakh.
opportunities.description:
Implemented by AICTE to support specially-abled students in technical education. opportunities.title: RBI Summer Placement 2027
opportunities.summary: Summer placement at the Reserve Bank of India for students in the penultimate year of PG, integrated or law courses in finance-related fields, with a ₹25,000 monthly stipend.
opportunities.description: The Reserve Bank of India offers summer placements to Indian students studying in India in management, statistics, law, commerce, economics, econometrics, banking or finance. Applications are made online between 15 October and 15 December of the previous year, for placements starting from April. The placement period may be reduced or extended at the Bank's discretion. Trainees coming from outside the city arrange their own accommodation.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Indian students in the penultimate year of a PG, integrated 5-year or 3-year full-time law course in management, statistics, law, commerce, economics, econometrics, banking or finance.
opportunities.benefits: Stipend of ₹25,000 per month (with effect from April 2027).
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Fill the online application form on RBI's opportunities website before 15 Dec 2026.
2. Apply well before the closing date — RBI warns that the website gets overloaded near the deadline.

opportunities.title: NITI Aayog Internship Scheme
opportunities.summary: Internship at NITI Aayog for UG/PG students and research scholars; apply online only between the 1st and 10th of any month.
opportunities.description: NITI Aayog takes interns who are enrolled in recognised universities and institutions in India or abroad. Applications are accepted online from 00:00 hrs on the 1st to 23:59 hrs on the 10th of every month; no other mode of application is accepted. You choose one area of interest. As per NITI's 2023 internship guidelines, the internship is unpaid, interns must have their own laptops, and at least 75% attendance is needed — below that, no experience certificate is issued.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate/postgraduate students or research scholars enrolled in recognised universities or institutions in India or abroad.
opportunities.benefits: Unpaid internship with an experience certificate (minimum 75% attendance).
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Open the internship page on NITI Aayog's website between the 1st and 10th of the month.
2. Fill the online registration form and choose one area of interest.
3. Apply up to six months in advance, but not later than two months before the month you want to start.
4. Note your Registration Number after submitting.
opportunities.deadline_note: Apply online between the 1st and 10th of any month

criteria.description: Enrolled UG/PG student or research scholar at a recognised university or institution

The portal connects students with verified opportunities across government internships (TULIP, Army, CDAC), Fortune 500 MNCs and corporates, and MSMEs. Each internship on the portal has its own eligibility, duration, stipend and last date — check the individual listing before applying.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students of AICTE, UGC, IGNOU and other institutions; each internship sets its own conditions.
opportunities.benefits: Many internships in one place, including government internships. Stipend and duration vary by listing.

opportunities.deadline_note: Listings added year-round; each has its own last date

opportunities.title: LAMP Fellowship 2027-28 (Legislative Assistants to Members of Parliament)
opportunities.summary: Work with a Member of Parliament for about a year with PRS Legislative Research, with a ₹23,000 monthly stipend. Applications open on 29 November.
opportunities.description:
The LAMP Fellowship places young graduates with Members of Parliament from the Monsoon session of Parliament to the end of the following Budget session. It starts in mid-June with a one-month training. Fellows must be in New Delhi for the whole fellowship and arrange their own accommodation.

Selection: an online application with a statement of purpose and an essay analysing a policy issue; shortlisted candidates take a mandatory online evaluation in January and are then interviewed. PRS says applications for 2027-28 open on 29 November; the closing date will be announced by PRS.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Indian citizens aged 25 or below (born on or after 1 June 2001) with a Bachelor's degree in any discipline, finished before the fellowship starts.
opportunities.benefits: Stipend of ₹23,000 per month during the fellowship.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Read the eligibility rules and FAQ on the PRS website.
2. When applications open (29 Nov), submit the online form with a statement of purpose and a policy essay.
3. If shortlisted, take the online evaluation in January, then the interview.
opportunities.deadline_note: Opens 29 Nov 2026 — closing date to be announced by PRS

opportunities.title: UPSC Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination 2027
opportunities.summary: UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2027: notification on 13 Jan 2027, applications until 2 Feb 2027, exam on 23 May 2027 — as per UPSC's official 2027 calendar.
opportunities.description: As per UPSC's Annual Calendar 2027 (uploaded on 20 May 2026), the notification for the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2027 is scheduled for 13 January 2027, with the last date for applications on 2 February 2027. The one-day preliminary exam is on Sunday, 23 May 2027, and the Civil Services (Main) Examination is scheduled from 20 August 2027 (5 days). Calendar dates can change — the official notification is final.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Age, educational qualification and attempt limits will be in the official notification, scheduled for 13 Jan 2027.
opportunities.benefits: First stage of the Civil Services Examination conducted by UPSC.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Read the official notification when UPSC publishes it (scheduled 13 Jan 2027).
2. Apply online on UPSC's website before the last date (2 Feb 2027 as per the calendar).

criteria.description: Meet the age, education and number-of-attempts rules in the official CSE 2027 notification

opportunities.title: National Career Service (NCS) Portal
opportunities.summary: Government of India's free jobs portal: job search and matching, career counselling and job fair information for all job seekers.
opportunities.description: Run by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, NCS is a one-stop platform for employment and career services — job search, job matching, career content, counselling and job fair information. It is used by job seekers, employers, skill providers, career counsellors, placement organisations and government departments. The NCS mobile app can be used to find and apply for jobs, and the toll-free helpline is 1514.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all job seekers in India.
opportunities.benefits: Free: NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application or interview processing.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Register as a jobseeker on ncs.gov.in or the NCS mobile app.
2. Complete your profile and search or get matched to jobs.
3. Apply for jobs and job fairs listed on the portal.

opportunities.title: Apprenticeships under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
opportunities.summary: Paid apprenticeships at registered establishments, with the Government paying 25% of the prescribed stipend (up to ₹1,500 a month) directly into the apprentice's bank account.
opportunities.description: Under NAPS-2 of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, establishments engage apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The Government shares part of the stipend — 25% of the minimum prescribed stipend, up to ₹1,500 per apprentice per month — paid by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the apprentice's bank account (DBT started from July 2023). This support is not paid during the basic training period for fresher apprentices. Apprenticeship openings are listed on the Apprenticeship India portal.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Apprentices engaged under the Apprentices Act, 1961 by an establishment registered on the apprenticeship portal.
opportunities.benefits: Monthly stipend from your employer, with the Government's share of 25% of the minimum prescribed stipend (up to ₹1,500 a month) paid to your bank account by DBT.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Visit the Apprenticeship India portal and follow the registration steps for candidates.
2. Search apprenticeship openings and apply.
3. Keep your bank account ready for DBT of the Government's stipend share.

criteria.description: Engaged as an apprentice under the Apprentices Act, 1961

documents.notes: For DBT of the Government's stipend share

opportunities.title: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH)
opportunities.summary: Government's digital skilling platform: find courses across schemes, train, get verifiable digital certificates and see jobs — in 22 Indian languages.
opportunities.description: Launched on 13 September 2023 by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship as digital public infrastructure for skilling. SIDH brings training, assessment, certification, crediting and employment onto one platform: discover skilling courses across government schemes (including PMKVY), manage your training from enrolment to certification, and receive tamper-proof, verifiable digital certificates. A Job Exchange shows vacancies from NSDC's JobX and the National Career Service. The platform is integrated with Bhashini for translation into 22 regional languages, and the Skill India Assistant works on WhatsApp. Fees depend on the scheme or training partner — check each course.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to anyone who wants to learn new skills; individual courses may have their own requirements.
opportunities.benefits: Courses across government skilling schemes, verifiable digital certificates and job listings in one place.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Create your profile on the Skill India Digital Hub.
2. Search courses and check each course's requirements and fees.
3. Enrol, train and download your digital certificate.

opportunities.title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Education Loans and Interest Subvention
opportunities.summary: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for students admitted on merit to top-ranked institutions, with interest help for family income up to ₹8 lakh.
opportunities.description: PM-Vidyalaxmi is a central sector scheme of the Ministry of Education for meritorious students in Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs) identified using NIRF rankings. Students apply on the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal with one common form and can apply to up to three banks. Loans up to ₹7.5 lakh get a 75% credit guarantee from the Government of India. For family income up to ₹8 lakh, there is a 3% interest subvention during the moratorium on loans up to ₹10 lakh (for up to one lakh students a year); for family income up to ₹4.5 lakh, full interest subvention during the moratorium on loans up to ₹10 lakh. Interest rates are set by each bank. Aadhaar is mandatory, and loans under management quota are not eligible.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Admitted on merit (not management quota) to an eligible NIRF-ranked institution; Aadhaar mandatory; interest help depends on family income.
opportunities.benefits: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan; 75% credit guarantee on loans up to ₹7.5 lakh; 3% interest subvention (family income up to ₹8 lakh) or full interest subvention (up to ₹4.5 lakh) during the moratorium on loans up to ₹10 lakh.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Sign up on pmvidyalaxmi.co.in.
2. Fill the Common Education Loan Application Form and choose up to three banks (one active application at a time).
3. Upload documents in PDF/JPEG format (max 200 KB each).
4. After your loan is sanctioned, claim interest subvention on the portal if you are eligible.

opportunities.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
opportunities.summary: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 lakh for non-farm micro enterprises through banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions.
opportunities.description: MUDRA loans support income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading and services, and activities allied to agriculture. There are four categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (above ₹50,000 up to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (above ₹5 lakh up to ₹10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (above ₹10 lakh up to ₹20 lakh, effective 24 October 2024, for entrepreneurs who have taken and successfully repaid a Tarun loan). Loans are given through banks, NBFCs, MFIs and other lending institutions.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals, proprietary concerns, partnership firms or companies running non-farm income-generating activities or agri-allied activities.
opportunities.benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishor up to ₹5 lakh; Tarun up to ₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh (for earlier Tarun borrowers who repaid).
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution with your business plan and the documents the lender asks for.

criteria.description: Business in manufacturing, trading, services or activities allied to agriculture (non-farm income generation)
Tarun Plus (₹10–20 lakh) is only for borrowers who repaid an earlier Tarun loan

opportunities.title: Stand-Up India
opportunities.summary: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs above 18 setting up a new enterprise.
opportunities.description: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch, for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or trading. For non-individual enterprises, at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake must be held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur. The composite loan covers assets and working capital, is repayable in up to 7 years with a moratorium of up to 18 months, and is covered by the Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Stand-Up India Loans. On the SIDBI-run Stand-Up India portal you can register as a Ready Borrower or a Trainee Borrower.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years, setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise.
opportunities.benefits: Composite loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore; repayable in up to 7 years with up to 18 months' moratorium; interest not above the bank's base rate (MCLR) + 3% + tenor premium; credit guarantee cover.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply directly at a bank branch, through the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in), or through your Lead District Manager (LDM).

criteria.excerpt: In case of non-individual enterprises at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either an SC/ST or Woman entrepreneur.

criteria.description: Setting up a greenfield (new) enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or trading
criteria.excerpt: This enterprise may be in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or the trading sector.

opportunities.title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
opportunities.summary: Subsidy of 15–35% of project cost for anyone above 18 setting up a new micro enterprise — projects up to ₹50 lakh in manufacturing.
opportunities.description: PMEGP, run by the Ministry of MSME and implemented by KVIC, gives a margin-money subsidy on bank-financed projects for new enterprises. General category beneficiaries contribute 10% and get a subsidy of 15% (urban) or 25% (rural); special categories — including SC/ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, and the North East, hill and border areas — contribute 5% and get 25% (urban) or 35% (rural). As per the revised guidelines, the maximum project cost is ₹50 lakh in manufacturing and ₹20 lakh in business/service. There is no income ceiling, and only one person per family (self and spouse) can be assisted.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any individual above 18; VIII pass for larger projects; one person per family; new enterprises only.
opportunities.benefits: Margin-money subsidy of 15% to 35% of the project cost, depending on your category and whether the unit is urban or rural.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online on the PMEGP e-portal run by KVIC and follow the steps shown there.

criteria.description: Above 18 years of age
criteria.excerpt: Any individual, above 18 years of age

Only one person per family (self and spouse), for setting up a new enterprise

opportunities.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana)
opportunities.summary: Small-savings account for a girl child below 10 — start with ₹250 and save up to ₹1.5 lakh a year; it matures 21 years after opening.
opportunities.description: A parent or guardian can open the account any time from the girl's birth until she turns 10. Only one account is allowed per girl, and a family can open accounts for up to two girls (more in the case of twins or triplets). The minimum opening deposit is ₹250; later deposits are in multiples of ₹50, with at least ₹250 in each financial year and a maximum of ₹1,50,000 a year (any excess earns no interest and is returned). Deposits can be made for up to 15 years from opening, and the account matures 21 years after it is opened. The girl must be a resident Indian.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For a girl child below 10 years, opened by a parent or guardian; up to two girls per family.
opportunities.benefits: Long-term savings for the girl child: deposit ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh a year for up to 15 years; the account matures after 21 years.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Open the account at a post office or an authorised bank branch with the girl's and the guardian's documents.
opportunities.deadline_note: Open any time before the girl turns 10

criteria.description: Girl child below 10 years of age, account opened by a parent or guardian
The girl is a resident Indian
Up to two accounts per family (more allowed for twins or triplets)

opportunities.title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
opportunities.summary: Grant of up to ₹20 lakh for proof-of-concept and prototypes, and up to ₹50 lakh debt support for market entry, for DPIIT-recognised startups under 2 years old — through selected incubators.
opportunities.description: Run by DPIIT under Startup India, the scheme supports early-stage startups through selected incubators. A grant of up to ₹20 lakh supports proof-of-concept validation, prototype development or product trials, released in milestone-based instalments. Up to ₹50 lakh is available through convertible debentures, debt or debt-linked instruments for market entry, commercialisation or scale-up. Each type of support can be taken only once. Startups apply online year-round and can choose up to three incubators in order of preference.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: DPIIT-recognised startup incorporated not more than 2 years ago, using technology at its core, with at least 51% Indian promoter shareholding.
opportunities.benefits: Grant up to ₹20 lakh (proof of concept, prototype, product trials) and up to ₹50 lakh through convertible debentures or debt (market entry, commercialisation, scale-up).
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Get DPIIT recognition for your startup.
2. Apply online on the Seed Fund portal and choose up to three incubators in order of preference.
3. Approved support is released by the incubator in milestones.

criteria.description: DPIIT-recognised startup incorporated not more than 2 years before applying
Indian promoters hold at least 51% of the startup
Uses technology in its core product or service, business model, distribution or solution
Has not received more than ₹10 lakh of monetary support from other central or state government schemes
Only startups can apply — not individual entrepreneurs
